excerpts.content:
If I got your question right then the `Union` was intended to handle this: 
```py
    Union [
        # Not yet confirmed competing headers
        List[PendingShardHeader, MAX_SHARD_HEADERS_PER_SHARD] 
        # Confirmed commitment
        DataCommitment
    ])
```
The intention was 
a) Immediately 'publish' the commitment as soon as it is confirmed (i.e. make it accessible via fixed path in the state tree). That could still be done with a dedicated rotating array though (not to be named 'pre-previous' or 'grandparent' in this case)
b) When commitment is confirmed get rid of unnecessary `PendingShardHeader` list for state size efficiency
